content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Executive Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Executive (C.A.R.E) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIM Kozhikode Executive (C.A.R.E) posts is 16th September 2026. It is advised to submit your application well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Executive (C.A.R.E) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Executive (C.A.R.E) position announced by IIM Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree (two-year full-time programme) in Management or allied disciplines from a recognized institution/university.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for the Executive (C.A.R.E) role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 7 years of experience in sales or business development is required for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Executive (C.A.R.E) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 75,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the IIM Kozhikode Executive (C.A.R.E) recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of IIM Kozhikode or via the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is on a contract basis.
